Name: accent
Used for: Links, focus outlines and selected buttons

Name: surface
Used for: Cards, panels and dropdowns, code blocks, and the dimmed background behind pop-ups

Name: surface-raised
Used for: Outlines of summary boxes, Home tiles, form fields and dropdowns, Timeline bars with no milestones, hover backgrounds, raised controls, and the second colour of the logo

Name: border
Used for: Borders, text on any highlight colour, and archived labels

Name: text
Used for: Main text and faint divider lines

Name: text-soft
Used for: Secondary and quiet text, and UNASSIGNED status

Name: green
Used for: Complete milestones, active projects, DONE status, priority A, and Review or Plan being due

Name: yellow
Used for: Milestones in progress, WAITING status, priority B, the last item in a milestone on the Plan page, Review or Plan due soon, and warnings

Name: orange
Used for: Milestones not started, inactive projects, ASSIGNED status, and unexpected files on Compatibility

Name: pink
Used for: Milestones with no tasks, priority C, sidebar items whose project is not active, errors and delete buttons

Name: purple
Used for: Sidebar items named in the latest focus, and entities to review

Name: cyan
Used for: Sidebar items whose project is in the latest focus, Suggested projects on the Plan page, and projects to review

Name: print-paper
Used for: The page colour of a printed report

Name: print-ink
Used for: Main text on a printed report

Name: print-ink-soft
Used for: Secondary text on a printed report

Name: print-line
Used for: Lines and borders on a printed report

Name: print-raised
Used for: Outlines of boxes and tiles on a printed report
